# @bangbang93/opencode-comment-checker

An [OpenCode](https://opencode.ai) plugin that makes the model justify or remove every comment it adds.

After a successful `edit` or `write`, the changed text is sent to the
[comment-checker](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/go-claude-code-comment-checker) binary (Rust + tree-sitter, 30+ languages).
When it finds a new comment, a warning is appended to the tool result, and the model has to explain the comment or delete it.

## Install

Add the package to `plugins` in `opencode.jsonc`:

```jsonc
{
  "plugins": ["@bangbang93/opencode-comment-checker@0.1.0"]
}
```

To run a checkout of the repository instead, point the entry at `packages/comment-checker`.

## Behavior

- `edit` and `write` are checked. `patch` and other tools are not.
- A session gets at most one warning every 30 seconds, and the window opens only once a warning was delivered.
- Comments that were already in the replaced text, and comments the checker allows (linter directives, BDD steps, shebangs), do not count.
- If the checker binary is missing or fails to start, the plugin logs `[comment-checker] disabled: …` once and does nothing else.

## Disable

Add `"-comment-checker"` to the `plugins` array.

## License

MIT. [NOTICE.md](./NOTICE.md) lists what this plugin derives from.

# Notice

This plugin re-implements the comment-checker hook of
[oh-my-openagent](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent) 5.1.24 for the OpenCode V2 plugin API.

## Sources

- Hook design: `packages/omo-opencode/src/hooks/comment-checker/` and `packages/comment-checker-core/` of
  oh-my-openagent 5.1.24, commit `fda8eb83630682c22a18e06b51b7366f843858b9` (Sustainable Use License v1.0).
  No source text from that package is included here.
- Checker binary: [code-yeongyu/go-claude-code-comment-checker](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/go-claude-code-comment-checker)
  v0.8.2 (MIT), installed as the npm package `@code-yeongyu/comment-checker`.

## Differences from the oh-my-openagent hook

- Built on `ctx.tool.hook("execute.after")` and covers the `edit` and `write` tools. The `patch` tool is not covered.
- The regex pre-filter is dropped because the checker takes about 2 ms per run.
- The per-session gap is recorded only when a warning is delivered, and concurrent checks no longer cancel each other.
- The warning is appended to `result.content`.

## Dependencies

- The plugin talks to the checker over its stdin JSON contract, so `@code-yeongyu/comment-checker` is pinned to an exact
  version. Its `postinstall` is only a fallback download from GitHub Releases. This workspace denies it in
  `pnpm-workspace.yaml`, so the binary always comes from the integrity-checked npm platform package.
- `@opencode/plugin` must stay compatible with the OpenCode release that loads the plugin.

## Disable

Add `"-comment-checker"` to the `plugins` array in `opencode.jsonc`.
